mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_period_close_book (id, period_close_id, ledger_book_id, as_of_sequence, final_trial_run_id, posting_instruction_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.periodCloseId}, #{row.ledgerBookId}, #{row.asOfSequence}, #{row.finalTrialRunId}, #{row.postingInstructionId}, #{row.status}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, period_close_id, ledger_book_id, as_of_sequence, final_trial_run_id, posting_instruction_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_period_close_book WHERE period_close_id = #{periodCloseId} ORDER BY ledger_book_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_period_close_book SET final_trial_run_id = #{finalTrialRunId}, status = 'FINALIZED', update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{book.id} AND status = 'LOCKED'
UPDATE t_period_close_book SET posting_instruction_id = #{instructionId}, status = 'FINALIZED', update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{book.id} AND status = 'LOCKED' AND posting_instruction_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_period_close_book b LEFT JOIN t_trial_balance_run r ON r.id = b.final_trial_run_id WHERE b.period_close_id = #{periodCloseId} AND (b.status <> 'FINALIZED' OR r.id IS NULL OR r.status <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR r.as_of_sequence <> b.as_of_sequence)
